assumptions_and_unknowns: The +0x60 field is a cumulative byte count (the refill helper adds each refilled block length to it) and +0x70 is a sticky flag set when a recyclable header is seen while that count equals the bytes remaining; what either field means at a higher level is not pinned.

The stream object at +0x78 and the helper object at +0xb0 are vtable contracts only: method slot +0x10 (read-like) and +0x18 (skip-like) on the stream, plus the create/use/cleanup calls at 0x543bde0, 0x543bed0 and 0x543dc30 on the helper. Their implementations are not pinned; the model takes them as caller-supplied callables.

The 4th argument of the window is a nullable out-pointer: NULL selects the plain stream-read assembly path, non-NULL selects the transform path and receives the cleanup call result. The cleanup result value itself is not pinned.
The CRC routine is reached through a PLT import, so its implementation is not pinned byte-for-byte; the model implements standard CRC-32C and the tests pin it against the published check value.
The block-source call at 0x52a87d0 is abstracted as a callback returning (status, chunk) for up to 0x8000 bytes; its argument layout beyond the size and the slice pair at +0x38 is not pinned.

The empty-buffer pointer stored on clear paths is 0x1e629b, the address of a NUL byte immediately before a cargo-registry path string; it is an empty-slice sentinel, not a claim about that path string.
Symbolic names for the return codes (beyond their triggering conditions) are not pinned; only the conditions and the caller acceptance range 0..15 are.

callers_of_refill.method: full executable-segment e8/e9 scans plus whole-file qword scan

callers_of_window.method: full executable-segment e8/e9 scans plus whole-file qword scan
callers_of_window.note: Both call sites pass the same argument shape and check the returned code against 15 (codes above 15 go to an error path); census only, the enclosing routine is not modeled here.

crc.covered_bytes: from the type byte through the end of the payload: header_size + length - 6 bytes starting at buffer + 6
crc.function: CRC-32C extended from seed 0 through a PLT import at 0x5421fc0

header.log_number_field: u32 at buffer + 7, recyclable headers only

refill_helper.error_path: nonzero read status clears the buffer, sets +0x49, returns retry-true with code 10; the next call then takes the leftover path and returns code 10
refill_helper.leftover_path: entered when +0x48 or +0x49 is set: remaining 0 returns code 10, remaining > 0 writes the leftover size to the out parameter, clears the buffer and returns code 12
refill_helper.short_block_rule: a block of 0x7fff bytes or fewer sets +0x48 and records its length at +0x50; a full 0x8000-byte block does not

relation_to_prior_items.1751: different container family (hashtable rehash); no overlap
relation_to_prior_items.1798: different container family (pending-key sweep); no overlap
relation_to_prior_items.1832: different container family (counted-key hashtable); the WAL reader struct here shares only the empty-sentinel address pattern, not the table layout

return_codes.11: zero-type record with zero length (buffer cleared), or negative stream/transform status (buffer cleared)
return_codes.12: leftover bytes too short for a header after the final block; leftover size written to the out parameter, buffer cleared
return_codes.13: recyclable log number differs from +0x68; buffer left untouched
return_codes.14: header plus payload extends past the remaining buffer; remaining size written to the out parameter, buffer cleared
return_codes.15: CRC mismatch; remaining size written to the out parameter, buffer cleared
return_codes.9: set-compression record; bypasses the transform path even when a stream object is present
return_codes.caller_acceptance: the logical-reader caller accepts 0..15 and treats above 15 as an error

window.returns: record type byte, or one of 10..15
window.summary: WAL physical-record decode: buffer state machine, block refill, 7/11-byte headers, log-number gate, CRC gate, fragment output

window_behavior.advance: on success the buffer pointer moves past header + payload and the remaining count drops by the same amount
window_behavior.fragment_output: plain path: the payload slice inside the buffer; stream/transform paths: the assembled scratch string at +0x88/+0x90
window_behavior.gate_order: header fit (14), then zero trailer (11), then log number (13, recyclable only), then CRC (15, only when +0x28 is nonzero)
window_behavior.loop_head_refill: remaining <= 6 refills for any type; a recyclable type with remaining <= 10 refills as well (it needs the 11-byte header)
window_behavior.scratch_reset: the scratch string is reset (length 0) before either stream/transform path

stream_paths.read_path: 4th argument NULL: repeated stream read calls until status == 0 with a short chunk; continue while status != 0 or the chunk is a full 0x8000-byte block
stream_paths.transform_path: 4th argument non-NULL: helper object created on first use, transform steps with the same loop condition, cleanup call on completion, cleanup result written to the 4th argument

window_behavior.type_9_bypass: type 9 returns the buffer payload directly even when a stream object is present
